steps.text: Go to the wasp tower in north-west Rookgaard and rope up four times to the top (wasps).
steps.source: Go to the Wasp tower in North-west Rookgaard. Rope yourself up killing or simply ignoring the Wasps you will face.

steps.text: Use the honey flower patch to the right: a honey flower.
steps.source: At the top simply "use" on the Honeyflower Patch to the right and you will get a Honey Flower.
Head to Lee'Delle's Shop, on premium account area, and trade your Honey Flower for a pair of Studded Legs.
Oh, thank you so much! Please take this piece of armor as reward.
